title: Jastrow v2 truth entry
description: Machine-readable spec of the v2 entry body model (docs/specs/2026-07-11-entry-body-model-design.md §2, decision B11) at schemaVersion 2 — the headword-design §2 shape, where headwords[] and an optional display template replace headword/altHeadwords. This schema is the documented generic spec of the format; examples in the design doc illustrate it, they do not define it.

schemaVersion.description: The entry-file format version. 2 is the headword-design §2 shape, ruled 2026-09-21. Stamped on every file so a reader can tell the versions apart without inferring it from which keys are present.

sefariaHeadword.description: Sefaria's headword for this rid, byte for byte (URL names spec §5.1, U3). Import is the only writer.

formerNames.description: Names this entry has published under and no longer holds (URL names spec §5.1, U6). Absent until publication: nothing writes it yet.

headwords.description: Every form print sets on the headword line, in its order. headwords[0] is the primary form: the name, the search key and every link derive from it (headword design §2).

display.description: How print laid the headword line out: a template whose {n} inserts headwords[n].text and whose every other character is literal notation, never Hebrew (headword design §2, §3.1). Optional and never defaulted — where the source cannot settle the layout the key is absent and the row is flagged (§3).

gender.description: This form's gender label, as print sets it beside the form (headword design §4). An entry carries at most one of a per-form gender on EVERY headword or a grammar.gender, never both, and neither is inherited.

partial.description: This form is shown exactly as printed and is never a lookup key (headword design §2): an ending after an ellipsis, or a phrase holding an abbreviated word. Only ever true.
